messages:
alex: Heads-up — we got a DSAR where the user insists data was deleted but their embeddings still surface in search. Looks like tombstone marker applied but not showing up in snapshots/backups. Any recent RBAC/service-account changes that could block delete propagation?

maria: That sounds like the tombstone write succeeded but the async cleanup job couldn't access the snapshot bucket. We rotated the service account last week — @sam did the rollout.

sam: yep rolled a new service acct for snapshot-worker on Tue. I updated IAM bindings but left the storage-sa out of the keyring rotation for safety. I can check logs.

alex: Can you confirm whether snapshot-worker has READ/WRITE on the snapshots project and also whether it can call the KMS key used to decrypt metadata? We have two KMS keys (eu and global) on different IAM policies.

maria: quick check: the worker uses the service account `service-snapshot@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. It needs roles/storage.objectAdmin + roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on projects/snapshots.

sam: looking at audit logs now. snippet: ```json
{"protoPayload": {"serviceName":"storage.googleapis.com","methodName":"storage.objects.get","authenticationInfo":{"principalEmail":"service-snapshot@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"},"status": {"code": 7}}}
```

sam: code 7 = PERMISSION_DENIED. So it failed to read snapshot blob at 2024-05-14T08:12:03Z — right when the tombstone job tried to reconcile.

toni: That would explain it. Two follow-ups: 1) Why did the SA lose perms during rotation? 2) How does this affect DSAR timelines/SLAs?

maria: For (1) I suspect the Terraform plan changed the project-level binding inadvertently when we removed the old key. We need to check the TF state. For (2) legal wants proof of attempted erasure; we should record the failed reconcile and remediation steps.

kate.legal: Please capture the timeline and attempted writes. If we cannot complete erasure within the statutory window, legal will need to communicate with the requester. Evidence of attempted deletion plus remediation plan is critical.

sam: I opened a quick PR to add a test that validates SA has storage and KMS permissions before rotation: https://git.redwood/snapshot-worker/pull/412 — still iterating.

alex: Immediate mitigation: can someone re-add roles/storage.objectAdmin to the SA and re-run tombstone reconciler for the affected user id? If we need an exception, tag it as retention-exception pending legal.

infra-bot: deploy request accepted — `grant-storage-admin-to-service-snapshot` queued, ETA ~6m.

maria: I manually re-granted the storage role and added cloudkms decrypter on the eu key. Running reconciliation now: `./reconcile --user 0x9f2a --dry-run` -> found 1 snapshot with tombstone pending.

sam: After running reconcile (non-dry): `./reconcile --user 0x9f2a` exit 0, returned tombstone applied in snapshot metadata. Confirmed object rewrite with tombstone flag and zeroed vector index.

alex: Great. Can we add a short playbook step to DSAR handler: before declaring completion, verify tombstone present in snapshot and backups (or list of snapshots) and record KMS + SA check?

maria: I'll add a checkbox in DSAR runbook and a CICD test: `snapshot-worker/permissions_check`. Also we should add an alert if reconcile returns PERMISSION_DENIED.

toni: For longer-term: consider ephemeral encryption keys for snapshot metadata so deletes are easier (delete key => instant unrecoverability) vs relying on blob edits. Might help with legal proof too but need legal sign-off.

kate.legal: Ephemeral keys could work but legal needs to review data retention obligations and any litigation hold scenarios. We can't make data irrecoverable if there's a valid legal hold.

alex: Action items recap: 1) sam: add pre-rotation permission test (PR #412) — due EOD. 2) maria: update DSAR runbook with snapshot verification + alert — due tomorrow. 3) infra: review recent TF changes that rotated SA perms and revert/fix drift. 4) legal: confirm communication template for delayed erasure.

sam: noted. I'll follow up with a small play-through and attach logs to the DSAR ticket.

maria: attaching logs and reconciliation output to ticket 2024-8452. Will also add a timestamped evidence file and mark state=attempted-delete.

alex: Thanks all. Closing loop: once infra confirms TF fix, we'll add a retrospective in next security retro and consider the ephemeral-key proposal for scope and risk. :thumbsup:
